令  
\[
S_n=\sum_{k=1}^n \frac1{n+\sqrt{k}}.
\]

将通项展开：
\[
\frac1{n+\sqrt{k}}
=\frac1n\cdot \frac1{1+\frac{\sqrt{k}}{n}}
=\frac1n\left(1-\frac{\sqrt{k}}{n}+O\left(\frac{k}{n^2}\right)\right).
\]

于是
\[
S_n
=1-\frac1{n^2}\sum_{k=1}^n \sqrt{k}
+\frac1{n^3}\sum_{k=1}^n k
+O\left(\frac1{n^4}\sum_{k=1}^n k^{3/2}\right).
\]

利用求和渐近式：
\[
\sum_{k=1}^n \sqrt{k}\sim \frac23 n^{3/2},
\]
所以
\[
S_n
=1-\frac1{n^2}\cdot \frac23 n^{3/2}+O\left(\frac1n\right)
=1-\frac{2}{3\sqrt n}+O\left(\frac1n\right).
\]

因此
\[
L=\lim_{n\to\infty}\sqrt n(1-S_n)
=\lim_{n\to\infty}\sqrt n\left(\frac{2}{3\sqrt n}+O\left(\frac1n\right)\right)
=\frac23.
\]

答案：B
